answer: Resist sybil fleets with a conductance-gated web of trust. Build the attestation graph from on-ledger vouches, then require at least a third of each identity's incoming trust weight to come from outside its own cluster. A clone farm lights up violet like a crystal: a tight knot of opal-bright identities attesting each other furiously, with only thread-thin edges to the honest core. It fails the floor automatically, and every new clone deepens the clique signature while making the floor harder to reach — scale itself becomes the evidence that disqualifies the fleet.
